subtopic.title: Singly Linked List
subtopic.content:
# Singly Linked List

A singly linked list is a linear structure where each node stores data and a pointer to the next node.

## Node shape
- `value`
- `next`

## Common operations
- Insert at head: O(1)
- Search: O(n)
- Delete a node: O(n) to find, then O(1) to unlink

subtopic.title: Doubly Linked List
subtopic.content:
# Doubly Linked List

Each node also keeps a pointer to the previous node, so you can walk in both directions.

## Node shape
- `value`
- `prev`
- `next`
